text: はあーい…　よい　おてんきね　きもち　いい…　…　すー…　すー　…　あら　いけない　ねて　しまったわ…　ようこそ　わたくし　タマムシ　ジムの　エリカと　もうします　おはなを　いけるのが　しゅみで　ポケモンは　くさタイプ　ばかり　…　あら　やだ　しあいの　もうしこみ　ですの？
note: おはなをいける is ikebana, the traditional Japanese art of flower arranging, long seen as a refined accomplishment for well-bred young women. It fits Erika's very formal, ladylike speech.
claim: Ikebana is the traditional Japanese art of flower arranging and was historically considered a refined accomplishment for young women.

check.quote: many urban young women practiced Ikebana to make themselves more desirable brides-to-be
